en:
When you were explaining that the door to the
roof was locked, you said...

Also, I never went to the roof, not even
for the meeting.
But later, you said...

Since the mansion was on top of a hill, the
roof was pretty high up, right?

Past the brick handrail, the roof
was at a pretty steep slope...

And the slope faced the chapel wall. 
On top of that, there was snow on the roof.

That's a lot of specific information. Stuff
you wouldn't know if you hadn't been there.

Oh, yeah! Now that you mention it...how *did*
ya know all that stuff!?

You could probably see the steep slope
of the roof from outside the mansion.

But you wouldn't know about the brick handrail
unless you went up to the roof yourself.
H-Huh? Wh-Wh-What...?

What's this all about, Kokichi?
Did you actually go to the rooftop?

I-I-I...d-didn't...
I already t-told you that b-before...
Why you look so nervous?
Is this a sincere reaction?

B-But...there's no e-evidence that 
p-proves I went to the r-roof...

Oh, wait! I remember now!
That thing Himiko said!
Nyeh!? M-Me!?

At the start of the class trial, I remember
you saying the <CLT=cltSTRONG>handrail was made of bricks<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Ooohhh! You so clumsy, girl!
Gotta be more careful there, Himiko!
I-Is it my fault...?
Himiko really say that?
She toootally said that!
No she didn't!
Yes, she did!
She did not!
She did too!

Then when!? Tell me how long ago!
In hours, minutes, and seconds!
Puhuhu, what a worthless fight.

Stop them, Grandpa! All this terrible
fighting is bad for the baby!

Yeah, Grandfather! Stop them before
your grandkid is born!
I'm not gonna apologize! Cuz Himiko said it!
Grgh—! So damn stubborn!

How much longer are you going to
behave like this?
<CLT=cltMIND>We don't have time for this...

<CLT=cltMIND>But Kokichi is stubborn.
He won't fess up, no matter what.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if he's being this stubborn,
it makes me think he has something to hide.

<CLT=cltMIND>To get him to show his hand,
I have to prove he was on the roof.

<CLT=cltMIND>I might not like it, but...
I have to be aggressive.

<CLT=cltMIND>If we don't get the whole truth now,
everyone's lives are in danger.
